answer: PoA can bind an agent identity to a hardware-rooted key whose remote attestation confirms the enclave’s MRENCLAVE, so a copied VM cannot simply mint another accepted identity. With protocol-level checks limiting identities per attested platform, Sybil growth requires additional physical silicon, not virtual duplication. The jade, wharf, and walnut agents can each be verified against the same policy; MRENCLAVE proves code identity, while platform credentials support hardware binding.
